name: open-in-vscode
title: Open in Editor
description: Returns a list of code projects to open in the editor
author: danphilibin

commands.name: code
commands.title: Code
commands.description: Open the selected directory in the Editor.

preferences.name: startDirectory
preferences.title: Start directory
preferences.description: Starting directory for the command. ~ is expanded into your home directory

preferences.name: projectHints
preferences.title: Project hints (Legacy)
preferences.description: Legacy setting. Use 'Root Project Hints' and 'Package Hints' for better monorepo support.

preferences.name: rootProjectHints
preferences.title: Root project hints
preferences.description: Files/folders that indicate a project root (like monorepo root). Search continues for packages within.

preferences.name: packageHints
preferences.default: package.json, Cargo.toml, go.mod, requirements.txt, pom.xml, build.gradle
preferences.title: Package hints
preferences.description: Files that indicate individual packages or subprojects within a monorepo.

preferences.name: showMonorepoRoot
preferences.title: Show monorepo root
preferences.label: Include monorepo root directories
preferences.description: Include monorepo root directories in the results along with individual packages.

preferences.name: maxLevels
preferences.title: Number of levels to search
preferences.description: How many levels of folders to scan for projects. Maximum of 5.

preferences.name: codeAppName
preferences.title: 'Open With' application name'
preferences.description: Projects will be opened with this application.
